subject: Discovery recap & integration/onboarding plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed PoC plan

Hi Lisa 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and the proposed next steps so we can align with your engineering and infra teams:

Summary of pain points
- Search relevance and customer-facing latency spikes on peak traffic  currently 400-600ms P95 on generation calls.
- High per-request costs due to no batching and limited caching; budget pressure for holiday season.
- Need strict data residency and audit logs for user-generated content.

Current stack & constraints
- Backend: Node.js microservices on AWS (EKS)
- Existing model calls go through a shared inference endpoint managed by an infra team (no dedicated capacity)
- Primary SDKs: server-side JavaScript + a small Python infra team for analytics

Success criteria for PoC
- Achieve <=200ms P95 for user prompt generation on a representative load (traffic profile I shared)
- Reduce per-token cost by ~30% using batching/caching/quantization recommendations
- Demonstrate audit logs and region-restricted hosting for EU traffic

Proposed PoC scope & timeline
- Kickoff & account setup (this week): exchange access and assign technical owners
- Integration (2 weeks): quick SDK integration (Node.js) + sample routing to a dedicated inference pool
- Validation (1 week): run traffic replay, capture metrics, and review quality regressions
- Review & next steps: rollout plan for Dedicated or Hosted with reserved capacity

Owners / next meeting
- FastRetail owner: Lisa Tran (product lead)
- FastRetail technical lead: TBD (please confirm who will own infra tasks)
- Redwood owner: Jonas Weber (sales) and Marissa Cole (solutions engineer)

Attachments: poc-scope.xlsx (high-level milestones), redwood-infra-checklist.pdf (security items)

Next step: Can you confirm the technical owner and availability for a 30-minute integration kickoff on Wed or Thu? Once confirmed, Marissa will share the Node.js quickstart and a stub workload script.

Thanks  talk soon.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed PoC plan

Hi all 

Attached are the Node.js quickstart (README + example) and the SOC2-extract.pdf we typically share with infra teams. A couple of technical notes ahead of the kickoff:

- SDK: We'll provide the official Node.js SDK and a minimal Express-based integration (no changes to your frontend).
- API compatibility: Redwood supports standard REST/JSON generation and streaming; if you use gRPC or custom proxies we can advise on a small adapter layer.
- PoC workload: please provide a 10-minute traffic replay (canned sample of ~10k requests) or coordinate with us to run a live ramp.
- Milestones in spreadsheet: account setup, initial integration, load validation, quality check, and final review.

Attachments included: poc-scope.xlsx, redwood-infra-checklist.pdf, nodejs-quickstart.zip (attachment stub).

I'll be on the kickoff to help with env setup and to meet Marco.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
